rv.q: Credit to all the company for allowing us to do just that, albeit for too short a time.
The fleet evening, a 70-minute masterpiece in improvised comedy, has a cast of seven improvising a film based on audience suggestions.

Some wanted a superhero saga, others a tale for Christmas. But it was the shout out from a doctor in the house – useful during these COVID-era times, one imagines – that led to a devised musical set at the Royal Surrey County Hospital and telling of love affairs gone awry and appendectomies gone wrong.

cn.t: Mischief Theatre's improvised comedy delivers merriment through audience-suggested movie scenarios, with critics praising the troupe's ability to generate laughs even amid challenging circumstances.
